description: Admin 收貨問題 (receiving issues) page never shows CN receiving mismatches: listReceivingMismatches (apps/backend/src/db/receiving.ts:774) only reads receiving_invoice_items (HK flow); CN flow flags live in receiving_invoice_items_cn, so CN operators' 標記 records are invisible to admins and stay open forever
reproSteps: PDA CN receiving scan → flag a group (missing/damaged/wrong_part) → open Admin → 問題 → 收貨問題 → the CN mismatch does not appear (page shows 暫無未處理的收貨差異 even with 10 open CN mismatch rows)
remarks: Found while capturing user-guide screenshots (docs/user-guide/capture-runbook.md). Fix: union receiving_invoice_items_cn into the admin mismatch list (+ confirm/cancel endpoints), mirroring the CN trio pattern used elsewhere
